from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow reported by one company for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company that filed this 10-Q")
    cash_flow_value: float | None = Field(description="Operating cash flow amount as a signed float; negative for 'used in', positive for 'provided by'")
    cash_flow_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    label_text: str | None = Field(description="The label as written on the cash flow statement (e.g., 'Net cash used in operating activities', 'Net Cash Provided by Operating Activities')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt showing the operating cash flow line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flows: list[OperatingCashFlow]
